input.command: python3 -c 'import duckdb, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; from pathlib import Path; out=Path("out"); df=duckdb.sql("SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, CAST(sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS BIGINT) AS pedestrians_killed FROM read_parquet(\"data/crashes.parquet\") WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year").df(); assert list(df["year"]) == list(range(2013, 2026)); df.to_csv(out / "values_1.csv", index=False); fig, ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.5)); bars=ax.bar(df["year"].astype(str), df["pedestrians_killed"], color="#3977a8", width=0.72); ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3, fontsize=9); ax.set_title("Pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes by year"); ax.set_xlabel("Year of crash"); ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed"); ax.set_ylim(0, max(df["pedestrians_killed"])*1.17); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=160); plt.close(fig); print(df.to_string(index=False))'
